summary: iOThree Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of extraordinary general meeting to approve an increase in authorized share capital, an 8-for-1 reverse share split, and a discretionary further share consolidation within a 1-for-2 to 1-for-50 range. These proposals are routine capital structure changes, likely to address Nasdaq listing requirements. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is indicated.
